name: google-ads-gad-source-no-gclid
description: Google Ads landing whose gclid was stripped (link tracking protection) but gad_source and gad_campaignid survive, arriving from google.com.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (#82, parity with click-trail-handler#231): gad_source is a paid marker for Google Ads (medium defaults to cpc, paid_search). gad_source and gad_campaignid are stored as ft_/lt_/top-level fields but are NOT click IDs: never in click_id_history or the selected click ID. Semver: classification change, CLASSIFIER_VERSION 1.3.0; additive payload keys, SCHEMA_VERSION 1.3.0.
